verdict.rationale: Freshworks' own llms.txt states the CRM can 'Sync with Gmail/Outlook,' so a first-party Gmail/Outlook email sync is claimed. That is the only mention, and nothing describes how the sync works. missing for 10: evidence of two-way sync, automatic logging and matching of emails to the correct contact/deal records, setup and connection docs, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records
